knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE, message = FALSE, warning = FALSE)

## Task 1 — Generate the course dataset

```{r task1}
source("R/simulate_bdat602_data.R")

health_small <- simulate_bdat602(n = 10000, seed = 602)

dim(health_small)
names(health_small)
```

The dataset has 10,000 rows and 40 columns.

## Task 2 — First-pass EDA with skimr

```{r task2}
library(skimr)

skim(health_small)
```

From the skim output: the dataset has **26 numeric** columns and **7 character** columns (plus date and logical columns).

## Task 3 — Churn rate

```{r task3}
library(dplyr)

health_small |>
  summarise(churn_rate_pct = round(mean(churned) * 100, 2))
```

The churn rate is approximately **22–24 %** — a moderately imbalanced binary target that will require careful evaluation in Module 5.
